That 403 Forbidden error on the audio stream link (/rd-notebooklm/...) indicates a permission or authentication mismatch when your browser tries to fetch the audio file.
Here are the most common reasons this happens and how to fix it:
1. Multiple Google Accounts Signed In (Most Common)
If you are logged into more than one Google account in the same browser, the background request to stream or download the audio file might be sent under your secondary Google account instead of the account that owns the notebook.
Fix: Try opening the notebook in an Incognito / Private window and sign in only with the Google account that owns this notebook, then try downloading again.
2. Expired Authentication Session
The security token granting access to generated media files can sometimes expire if the page has been open for a while.
Fix: Refresh the browser page, or log out of your account and log back in to refresh your authorization token.
3. Browser Extensions or VPN Interference
Strict privacy extensions, ad blockers, or corporate VPNs can sometimes strip the necessary authentication cookies from background media links.
Fix: Temporarily disable ad blockers/extensions for Gemini Notebook, or check if turning off your VPN resolves the error.
